[D] Bidders are advised to take note of the “One Bid per Bidder” policy stipulated under Para 29 of the Ge M GTC. Accordingly: (i). For the same item/product in a BID/tender, either the Principal/OEM itself or its authorized agent/dealer may submit a bid. Both cannot participate simultaneously.

(ii). An authorized agent/dealer submitting a bid on behalf of a Principal/OEM shall not submit another bid o n behalf of any other Principal/OEM for the same item/product in the same tender. (iii). Multiple offers from the same OEM through different bidders are not permitted (in terms of NR vigilanc e advise system improvement letter no. E-S/Vig/SI/GeM GTC Compliance/2025 dated 03.07.2025) The OEM is advised to issue tender-specific authorization to only one firm for the particular item/product. (iv). In case multiple bidders submit offers representing the same OEM, or otherwise violate the above pro visions, the offers of all such bidders shall be disqualified in accordance with Para 29 of the GeM GTC and as per NR policy. [F] Warranty Clause : Minimum warranty period 12 months or higher, as specified by OEM shall apply fro m the date of successful delivery whichever is higher. .
